text:
ana: Quick report - reproducible JSON.parse crash in web + mobile sample apps when long SSE streams cross token rotation. Repro on both Node sample and RN sample with our polyfills.

liam: Is this limited to a specific SDK version or polyfill?

ana: (typo) ana: JS SDK v2.4.3 + RN SDK v1.9.0, eventsource polyfill in web, fetch/eventsource combo on mobile. Happens when token rotation happens ~20-40s into a stream.

zoe: Do you have raw SSE snippets? That usually helps show if fragments are interleaving.

ana: ana: Pasted trimmed capture:

[data] data: {"mid":"m-10","frag":"hello wo"
[data] data: {"mid":"m-10","frag":"rld"}
[data] data: {"mid":"m-11","frag":"next"}

When rotation overlaps we sometimes see:

[data] data: {"mid":"m-10","frag":"hello "}
[data] data: {"mid":"m-11","frag":"next"}
[data] data: {"mid":"m-10","frag":"world"}

That interleaving leads to client emitting m-11 then a trailing chunk that gets concatenated and breaks JSON.parse.

liam: So two windows: old socket still draining while new socket starts. Polyfills tend to pipe events as soon as they arrive.

zoe: Are we setting last-event-id or resume token on reconnect? I thought resume semantics might help.

ana: ana: Server sends resume-token header, but it's at message granularity. Fragments for the same message can still reorder. We don't have per-fragment metadata yet.

rachel: Proposed short-term mitigation: SDKs should buffer partial fragments keyed by message id and only attempt parse on a known boundary (frag_done) or after a small reassembly timeout. Also add a guard on token refresh: wait for 'close' before creating new EventSource if possible.

liam: Agree. Short-term client guard is easiest to ship, but we still need infra changes for robust behavior. Buffering needs careful timeouts to avoid memory blow-ups on mobile.

zoe: Mid-term infra change: add fragment_seq and frag_done metadata in SSE data envelopes, and ensure resume-token persists across reconnects. That way clients can reorder deterministically and detect missing fragments.

ana: ana: I implemented a quick buffer in the web sample that groups fragments by mid and waits up to 500ms for more parts before parsing. It reduced errors locally. Mobile RN needed a slightly different approach because background/foreground causes socket pause/resume; I added a 1s grace window on reopen.

liam: We should also sync SDK parity: web, node, python, mobile should share the same reassembly logic and tests. Add unit tests that feed partial JSON strings and out-of-order fragments.

zoe: E2E tests: create a proxy harness that introduces configurable overlap (0-700ms), random reorder, and cached-chunk replay to simulate polyfill behavior. Run nightly against staging.

rachel: Telemetry: emit a parse_error event that includes resume-token, sdk-version, polyfill name/version, and hashed client id so we can measure impact. Start with sampling to avoid noise.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app + sdk patches with buffering and close-guard pushed to staging for smoke tests.

liam: I'll open infra ticket to add fragment_seq + frag_done (INFRA-412). Zoe, can you own cross-SDK test harness?

zoe: Yes, will carve out time next sprint. Will also add parser unit tests in python and node SDKs.

ana: ana: Filed issues: devex#711 (sdk buffering + close-guard), infra#412 (sse fragment_seq + frag_done), e2e#240 (sse-overlap-harness). Adding PRs for web & RN sample-apps. Thanks! :thumbsup:
